name: Story of Seasons: Pioneers of Olive Town - Expansion Pass
summary: This expansive bundle will enhance your life on the farm even further with new characters, costumes, and more. Includes two story scenarios "Olive Town Mystery Files" and "The Legendary Sprite Dance". Includes the Windswept Falls, Terracotta Oasis and Twilight Isle mini-towns. Includes additional outfits and animal costumes for marriage candidates.
